text.p: Morgan Stockbroking Ltd has recommended Davids Ltd as a buy, citing the independent grocery distributor's rapid expansion and future earnings potential.
"Recommendation is buy. Davids has expanded rapidly and future earnings growth justifies investment at current prices," Morgan analyst John Clifford said in a report.
Davids' sales and profits were forecast to grow strongly in the current year ended June 30, 1997, although earnings per share would again be restricted by the expanded capital base, Clifford said.
The group's balance sheet was relatively highly geared at 79 percent, Clifford said.
"However net interest cover of 4.1 remains reasonably comfortable," he said.
"We expect to see gearing decline from these levels with any further acquisitions to be funded through equity," he said.
